real_model.summary_review: Actual supplier/order IDs, statuses, quantities, line totals and CNY units independently matched the executor summary. Raw model revision text preserved separately from deterministic facts.

failure_explanations: Initial seven missing endpoint/outbox cases failed before implementation.
Orphan submit evidence lacking execution_started incorrectly authorized a replay: fixed consumer/restart and standalone execute guards; original rejections retained.

Continuous approval can already be EXECUTING at the first UI poll: comparator now requires persisted human approval and exact task/version/hash/dataset, zero separate execute clicks; wrong/missing proof controls still reject.

A recorded owned process briefly survived Supervisor.stop after root termination: capture identities before stopping and require all recorded descendants to exit before return. Original assertion preserved.
One startup test selected a non-pinned CLI: runtime correctly rejected it. Same entry rerun with project CLI 0.166.0-alpha.5.1 passed; no protection disabled.
isolation: Temporary SQLite databases, independent loopback ports, synthetic business data and local test portal; real provider key supplied only in process environment. Existing user database and .env not reset.
closing_review: Same Agent performed separate closing review, saved additional orphan/replay failures, and ran concurrent consumers after the frozen real-model run. No independent-person review claim.
